Several days (10 missions; mission 5 needs a group of 4)

Yalahar is being attacked by vampires. Help the inquisitor {npc:Julius} unmask the vampires hidden in the city, map the island of {wiki:Vengoth|Vengoth}, enter the cursed castle and destroy the four vampire brothers: {creature:Boreth}, {creature:Lersatio}, {creature:Marziel} and {creature:Arthei}. At the end you get access to Vengoth and the castle, the {item:Vampiric Crest} (used in the {wiki:Yalaharian Outfits Quest|Yalaharian} addons), about 13200 experience and, optionally, the {item:Blood Goblet}.
Yalahar is under attack by vampires. Help Julius save Yalahar!
Mission 5: a group of **4 players** with {item:Blood Crystal (Charged)|charged Blood Crystals} (in the same mission or who have already done it).
Mission 9: at least **one female character** in the group (may have already done the quest).
If you've already done mission 3 (Vampire Hunt) of {wiki:The Inquisition Quest|The Inquisition Quest}, you skip mission 1 and start directly at mission 2.
only for mission 1 (you must have it equipped when talking to Julius)
one for the Garlic Bread (mission 1) and another for the Garlic Cookies (mission 2); buy from Henricus
one per recipe; sold by Brasith (Ab'Dendriel) or Jezzara (Ankrahmun)
one per recipe; grind {item:Bunch of Wheat} (from Donald McRonald or harvested)
missions 7 to 10, to collect each vampire brother's dust
used in the {wiki:Yalaharian Outfits Quest|Yalaharian Outfits Quest} for an addon
Experience bonus for marking more than 5 locations in Vengoth (up to 7500 exp if you mark all 8)
1000 experience for each extra diary page handed in to Julius (optional)
optional, at the end of mission 10
Harlow's boat between Yalahar and Vengoth
From mission 4 (*The Dark Lands*): talk to {npc:Harlow} at the Trade Quarter docks ({key:vengoth}).
100 gp to go and 50 gp to come back.
From mission 4 (*The Dark Lands*), on {npc:Harlow}'s boat; when you complete the quest you get access to Vengoth.
First entry in mission 5 (*Into the Castle*), with 4 players carrying {item:Blood Crystal (Charged)|charged Blood Crystals}; when you complete the quest you get access to the castle.
From mission 4 (*The Dark Lands*), on {npc:Harlow}'s boat.
Vengoth portal to the Spirit Grounds
From mission 4 (*The Dark Lands*): the portal is on the south coast of Vengoth.
It only opens one portal per day (Kha'zeel, Vengoth or Ghostlands); you need Premium.
An addon of the Yalaharian Outfits
The {item:Vampiric Crest} you receive at the end is used in the {wiki:Yalaharian Outfits Quest} for an addon.
Mission *The Curse Spreads* of the Grimvale Quest
Requires this quest done up to mission 3 (access to Vengoth).
Boss Katex Blood Tongue (mission *Sweet Dreams* of the Threatened Dreams Quest)
Requires this quest up to mission 3, plus the missions *The Curse Spreads* and *An Ancient Feud* of the {wiki:Grimvale Quest}.

Prepare the ingredients before you start: 2 {item:Special Flask (Holy Water)|Holy Water}, 2 {item:Flour}, 2 {item:Bulb of Garlic} and a {item:Baking Tray}. The most convenient oven ({item:Oven}) is right above Julius.

In missions 6 to 10 you'll walk the route between the boat in Vengoth and the castle entrance in the mountains about a dozen times. If you do everything in a row, it helps to have two friends clearing that route.
Bring several spare {item:Blessed Wooden Stake|Blessed Wooden Stakes}: without a stake you can't collect the vampire brothers' dust.
If you want the {wiki:Castlemania|Castlemania} achievement, mark all 8 Vengoth locations in mission 4, hand in all the diary pages and pick up the Blood Goblet in mission 10.
If you've already completed mission 3 (Vampire Hunt) of {wiki:The Inquisition Quest|The Inquisition Quest}, skip this mission and start at section 2.
Go to Yalahar's {wiki:Trade Quarter|Trade Quarter} and talk to {npc:Julius}. Say {key:hi}, then {key:vampire} (or {key:note}) and {key:yes}. He wants proof that you're not a vampire.
Equip a {item:Garlic Necklace} and say {key:mission}. Julius thinks the necklace isn't enough and asks you for {item:Garlic Bread}. Answer {key:no} (you've never made it) and then {key:yes}.
Without the {item:Garlic Necklace} equipped, Julius just replies *"I fear that will not do. Sorry."*

Buy {item:Special Flask (Holy Water)|Holy Water} from {npc:Henricus} (inquisitor in Thais). Get {item:Flour}: obtain {item:Bunch of Wheat} from {npc:Donald McRonald} or by harvesting wheat, and grind it into flour. Buy a {item:Bulb of Garlic} from {npc:Brasith} (Ab'Dendriel) or {npc:Jezzara} (Ankrahmun).

Use the {item:Flour} on the {item:Special Flask (Holy Water)|Holy Water} to get a {item:Lump of Holy Water Dough}. Then use that {item:Lump of Holy Water Dough} on the {item:Bulb of Garlic} to get a {item:Lump of Garlic Dough}.
Use the {item:Lump of Garlic Dough} on an {item:Oven|oven} to make the {item:Garlic Bread}. There's an oven on the floor **above Julius**.
Eat the bread in front of Julius
Go back to {npc:Julius}, say {key:mission}, eat the {item:Garlic Bread} in front of him and say {key:aaah}. Then accept the first real task with {key:yes} and {key:yes} again.
Julius wants you to trick Yalahar's citizens with {item:Garlic Cookie|Garlic Cookies} and note down the names of those who react suspiciously.
Prepare the dough and the baking tray

Use the {item:Flour} on the {item:Special Flask (Holy Water)|Holy Water}, then use the resulting dough on the {item:Bulb of Garlic}. Use the {item:Lump of Garlic Dough} on the {item:Baking Tray} to get a {item:Baking Tray (with Garlic Dough)}.
Use the tray on an {item:Oven|oven} (there's one right above Julius). You get 12 {item:Garlic Cookie|Garlic Cookies}; you only need **5**.
Hand out the cookies to the 5 suspects
Talk to each of these citizens ({key:hi}) and ask if they want a Garlic Cookie. Notice the suspicious reaction and note down the name. These are the {wiki:Suspected Vampires|suspected vampires}:
Go back to {npc:Julius}, say {key:mission} and {key:yes}. Then say the names **one at a time**: {key:maris}, {key:ortheus}, {key:serafin}, {key:lisander}, {key:armenius}. At the end answer {key:no}.
Say {key:mission} and {key:yes} again. Julius teaches you the magic words: repeat {key:alori mort}.
You only need to cast the spell on the chief vampire, {npc:Armenius}. The other four just send you away.
Go to {npc:Armenius}'s tavern in the Trade Quarter. Say {key:hi} and, **facing him directly**, say {key:alori mort}. He laughs and asks you to repeat: say {key:alori mort} again.
You're teleported to the Yalahar sewers.
You're teleported to his cellar, earn the achievement **His True Face** and face {creature:Armenius (Creature)|Armenius}.

If you got one of the first two outcomes, before going back to Julius return to the tavern and walk over the **two squares immediately east of the entrance**: you get one more small chance of earning the achievement **His True Face**.

If you're teleported to the Yalahar sewers, climb back up to the city by one of the manhole stairs (for example the ones in the **Inner City**: east of the Depot or next to the ramp to the Trade Quarter) and go back to Julius. If you end up in Armenius' cellar, when you kill him you're automatically teleported out of the room.
Go back to {npc:Julius}, say {key:mission} and answer {key:armenius}.
You're going to map the island of {wiki:Vengoth|Vengoth} with the {item:Julius' Map}. You need at least 5 strange locations, and the castle is mandatory.
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Julius} and accept with {key:yes}. You receive the {item:Julius' Map}.

Go to the **Trade Quarter** docks (straight **south** from the main gate) and talk to {npc:Harlow}: {key:hi}, {key:vengoth}, {key:yes} (100 gp; only from this mission on). He drops you off in the **west** of {wiki:Vengoth}.
Harlow in Vengoth (arrival and return point)
At each location, stand near the spot and **use the {item:Julius' Map}** to mark it. On the surface (floor 7) there are 5 locations:
small building with the NPC {npc:A Wandering Soul}
grave with the inscription *Shut your eyes Kiss me goodbye And sleep*
Reference for one of the locations to mark in Vengoth
Mark the locations in the mountains

Climb the mountain in the **southeast** of Vengoth and follow it, entering the {item:Strange Whirl|Strange Whirls}; the bridge over the abyss links this mountain to the castle's. To come down, go back the same way and through the same Strange Whirls. There are 3 locations here, including the **mandatory** one (the castle entrance). Since the castle is mandatory, it's worth marking all 3 on the mountain and only 2 on the surface.
Mark all 8 locations: Julius gives extra experience for each location above 5 (up to 7500 exp for all 8) and it's one of the requirements of the {wiki:Castlemania|Castlemania} achievement.

Go back to {npc:Harlow}, in the **west** of Vengoth, and say {key:hi}, {key:yalahar} and {key:yes} (50 gp). He takes you back to the Trade Quarter docks in Yalahar, near Julius. Do the same whenever you have to return to Julius in the following missions.
This mission has several parts: finding a {item:Blood Crystal}, charging it and entering the castle with 3 more players.

If you want to follow the clues, ask the Yalahar NPCs about {key:blood crystal}. The useful clue is {npc:Lorietta}'s: *"Why don't you check the cultist hideout in the magician quarter?"*. {npc:Ethan} says Tamara talked about it and {npc:Palimuth} suggests a magician. You can skip this and go straight to the next step.

Go to the {wiki:Magician Quarter/Research Centre|Magician Quarter Research Centre} in Yalahar (building at {coord:32826,31082,7}). Go in through the **level 30** {item:Gate of Expertise} and, on floor -1, pass through one of the **level 40** {item:Gate of Expertise|Gates of Expertise}.
You need level 40 to pass the second gate.

Go down to floor -3. Pass the {item:Door (Sealed)|quest door} and open the {item:Chest (Quest)|chest}: the {item:Blood Crystal} is inside. To leave, go back up the same floors and pass through both {item:Gate of Expertise|Gates of Expertise} again out to the street.
Go back to {npc:Julius}, say {key:mission}, {key:yes} and {key:yes}. He tells you that you have to charge the crystal with the energy of someone who lost everything.
Charge the crystal with A Wandering Soul
Travel to Vengoth again and go to the *haunted ruin*. Talk to {npc:A Wandering Soul} and say {key:blood crystal}. You get a {item:Blood Crystal (Charged)|Charged Blood Crystal}.
The crystal only stays charged for **24 hours** (while it glows). If you need to recharge it, go back and say {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:blood crystal}.
Go back to {npc:Julius} and say {key:mission}, {key:yes}, {key:yes} and {key:yes}. He explains that you need 3 more people with charged crystals.

Gather **4 players in total**, all with a {item:Blood Crystal (Charged)|charged Blood Crystal}. They can be on the same mission or have already done it. Anyone who has already done the mission buys a {item:Blood Crystal} from {npc:Black Bert}, but that crystal has to be charged at {npc:A Wandering Soul} by someone doing the mission for the first time.

Find the 4 {item:Strange Carving (Tile)|Strange Carvings} (partly buried) around the castle. Two are on the ground floor: one near the castle and another near the *poison shrine*, to the right and left of the entrance. Each player stands on one. When the 4th player steps on their spot, everyone is teleported to the castle corridor. There are no monsters inside.
Reference for the Strange Carvings around the castle

After entering the castle, leave the castle, go down the mountain through the {item:Strange Whirl|Strange Whirls}, take {npc:Harlow} back to Yalahar (see "Leave Vengoth") and go back to {npc:Julius} and report the mission (next section).
You have to find information about the castle: the first diary book.

In missions 6 to 10 you'll go to the castle often: in Yalahar say {key:hi}, {key:vengoth}, {key:yes} to {npc:Harlow}; in Vengoth climb the **southeast** mountain, follow it through the {item:Strange Whirl|Strange Whirls} and cross the bridge over the abyss to the castle entrance, in the mountains ({coord:32953,31488,6}).
This route has monsters and you'll walk it about a dozen times: if you can, ask two friends to keep it clear.
Enter the castle's main hall. Use the **south part** of the small {item:Old Carpet (Blue)} to find a {item:Closed Trapdoor}. Use the trapdoor to {item:Open Trapdoor|open} it and go down.
The trapdoor hidden under the blue carpet
Down there head **south**. You'll go through these rooms, in order:

You reach the **southeast** tower, which you can now access directly from the corridor whenever you want. In the {item:Bookcase (Quest)} in this room is the {item:Arthei's Descent into Vampirism I (Book)}.
The bookcase with the first diary book
Book II at the top of the tower (optional)
If you want another part of {creature:Marziel}'s diary already, climb to the top of the tower. Rooms in order:
Book II (Pile of Bones, top of the tower)
The {item:Arthei's Descent into Vampirism II (Book)} is in a {item:Pile of Bones (Quest)}, under a {item:Pile of Bones}.

Leave the castle the same way, take {npc:Harlow} back to Yalahar ({key:yalahar}) and go back to {npc:Julius}, say {key:mission} and answer {key:yes} three times (you found something, you hand in the book, you agree to continue).

From here on Julius gives **1000 experience** for each of the six {item:Old Piece of Paper|diary pages} you find hidden in containers in the castle. It's not mandatory, but it counts towards the {wiki:Castlemania|Castlemania} achievement.
You're going to kill the first of the vampire brothers. Bring a {item:Fire Bug} and a {item:Blessed Wooden Stake}.
Go down through the hall's {item:Open Trapdoor|trapdoor} again and head **west**. Rooms in order:

You now have direct access to the **southwest** tower from the corridor. Go up one floor: in room 7 there are 4 {creature:Haunted Treeling|Haunted Treelings}, 1 {creature:Mutated Rat} and 1 {creature:Vampire}. The {item:Arthei's Descent into Vampirism III (Book)} is in a {item:Chest of Drawers (Quest)} in this room.
Climb to the top of the tower
Climb to the top. Rooms in order:
In room 10, use the {item:Fire Bug} on the {item:Twines} **three times**. You're teleported to a room with {creature:Boreth} and 2 {creature:Plaguethrower|Plaguethrowers}.
The room at the top of the southwest tower
Kill Boreth and collect the dust
Kill {creature:Boreth}. Then use a {item:Blessed Wooden Stake} on his remains to get {item:The Dust of Boreth}.

With the dust, leave the vampire brother's room and go back the same way: go down the tower, return along the corridor to the trapdoor and climb to the main hall. Leave the castle, cross the bridge and go down the mountain through the {item:Strange Whirl|Strange Whirls}. In the **west** of Vengoth say {key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes} (50 gp) to {npc:Harlow}. Do the same at the end of missions 8, 9 and 10.
The second vampire brother. Bring a {item:Blessed Wooden Stake}.
Go down through the hall's {item:Open Trapdoor|trapdoor} and head **east**. Rooms in order:
Book IV in the northeast tower
You now have direct access to the **northeast** tower from the corridor. The {item:Arthei's Descent into Vampirism IV (Book)} is in a {item:Bookcase (Quest)} in this room.
Climb to the top of the tower
Climb to the top. Rooms in order:
In room 10, break **two of the mirrors**. You're teleported to a room with {creature:Lersatio} and 2 {creature:Vampire|Vampires}.
Kill Lersatio and collect the dust
Kill {creature:Lersatio} and use a {item:Blessed Wooden Stake} on his remains to get {item:The Dust of Lersatio}.
The third brother. You need a **female character** in the group, a {item:Vial of Blood} and a {item:Blessed Wooden Stake}.
Go down through the hall's {item:Open Trapdoor|trapdoor} and head **north**. Rooms in order:
Book V in the northwest tower
You now have direct access to the **northwest** tower from the corridor. The {item:Arthei's Descent into Vampirism V (Book)} is in a {item:Bookcase (Quest)} in this room.
Climb to the top of the tower
Climb to the top. Rooms in order:
In room 10, the female character steps on the square **right in front of** the {item:Vampire Lord Statue} and then steps off it. Next, use a {item:Vial of Blood} on that square.
The Vampire Lord Statue at the top of the northwest tower

2 {creature:Vampire Bride|Vampire Brides} appear: kill them and you're teleported to a room with {creature:Marziel} and 1 {creature:Vampire}. Kill Marziel and use a {item:Blessed Wooden Stake} on his remains to get {item:The Dust of Marziel}.
Go back to {npc:Julius}, say {key:mission} and confirm with {key:yes} to complete the mission.
The last and strongest of the brothers. Bring a {item:Blessed Wooden Stake}; you'll have 10 minutes to kill him.
Go down through the {item:Open Trapdoor|trapdoor} and head **north** again. Rooms in order:
In room 2, go in through the {item:Sealed Door} and follow the path. Rooms in order:
Book VI in the north tower
You now have direct access to the **north** tower from the corridor. The {item:Arthei's Descent into Vampirism VI (Book)} is in a {item:Bookcase (Quest)} in this room.
{creature:Hellspawn|Hellspawns} appear in large numbers in these rooms. Don't pull several rooms at once.
Go up to the NPC {npc:A Fading Memory} and say, in order: {key:hi}, {key:Kala}, {key:diary}, {key:yes}, {key:vampire}, {key:free soul}, {key:awaken}. You get a {item:Ghost's Tear}.
The {item:Arthei's Descent into Vampirism VII (Book)} is in the {item:Stone Coffin (Quest)} just to the right of {npc:A Fading Memory}.
Go up one more floor and use the {item:Ghost's Tear} **twice** on the {item:Vampire Lord Statue}. You're teleported to a room with {creature:Arthei} and 2 {creature:Vampire|Vampires}.
You have **10 minutes** to defeat Arthei.
Kill Arthei and collect the dust
Kill {creature:Arthei} and use a {item:Blessed Wooden Stake} on his remains to get {item:The Dust of Arthei}.

On the way down, go in through the {item:Sealed Door} you just unlocked, which gives access to the courtyard. Use the {item:Pile of Bones (Quest)} to get the {item:Blood Goblet}. You'll face 3 {creature:Hellspawn|Hellspawns}, 4 {creature:Werewolf|Werewolves} and 3 {creature:Vampire Bride|Vampire Brides}.
Blood Goblet (one of the requirements of the Castlemania achievement)
Take {item:The Dust of Arthei} to {npc:Julius} and report the mission ({key:mission}). He gives you the {item:Vampiric Crest}, used in the {wiki:Yalaharian Outfits Quest|Yalaharian Outfits Quest}.
On completing the quest you get access to Vengoth and the castle.

The {wiki:Castlemania|Castlemania} achievement requires marking all 8 locations in mission 4, handing in the diary pages, getting the {item:Blood Goblet} and also collecting 100 {item:Vampire Lord Token|Vampire Lord Tokens} from the {wiki:Vampire Hunter Quest|Vampire Hunter Quest} (the hardest requirement).
The **His True Face** achievement is rare and depends on luck when saying {key:alori mort} to Armenius (or when stepping on the two squares east of the tavern entrance).
